```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```

### Read In Datasets
```{r}
filepath <- "results/train_new_001"
training_files <- list.files(
  filepath,
  pattern = "train.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

testing_files <- list.files(
  filepath
  pattern = "test.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

### Create Datasets
```{r}
combined_training_data <- training_files %>%
  map_df(read_csv)

combined_training_data
```


```{r}
combined_test_data <- test_files %>%
  map_df(read_csv)

combined_test_data
```

### Create Patch Datasets
```{r}
patch_train_dataset <- combined_training_data %>%
  group_by(patch) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = epoch, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
patch_test_dataset <- combined_test_data %>%
  group_by(patch) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = epoch, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Draw Training Graphs
```{r}
ggplot(combined_training_data, aes(x = epoch, y = loss)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Loss",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_training_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Accuracy",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(patch_train_dataset, aes(x = epoch, y = loss)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Loss per Patch",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(patch_train_dataset, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Accuracy per Patch",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Draw Tesing Graphs
```{r}
ggplot(combined_test_data, aes(x = epoch, y = loss)) +
```
